lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Real work in the middle: a worker, a site, a risk owner.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Hey, the bracket by the packing line has cracked again. We're going to weld it before the night shift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora hears a repair, hot work, a place and a deadline. Then it asks for a photo.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next, it summons only the specialists this site and job need.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Each checks its own conditions and reports back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When everything holds, the route opens. Work goes on, the record is kept, no one is disturbed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then one condition slips. The fire watch is half what the policy asks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora brings it to the risk owner. Agents prepare; the human decides.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Risk is kept on purpose, with its terms explicit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mitigate compares safeguards, and checks whether the work is back inside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Transfer, simulated for now, asks outside capacity for terms and a price.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora carries the case between rooms. The risk owner stays in control.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Priora turns physical work into explicit risk decisions, while the work happens.
